Nadia, Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I posted that as a reply in your #strategic-pod thread.

His Jul 1 update first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280, because the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from their May rollout. The production roster as of Jul 1 shows 280 active seats, and Ruth acknowledged that number in the channel. Use 280 for the roster sheet.
